reason: Could not refute. Cited source (https://www.aus.edu/node/121001, AUS news on the Sharjah Tourism Innovation Hackathon 2025, held 1-2 November 2025) confirms: first place went to Team Hayyakum (Mahmoud Darwish, Amr Mohi Aldeen, Mohamad Dabbagh, Afif Zughayer) for "Sharjah Quest", prize AED 20,000 plus a presentation slot at SITTF 2025. The article describes an "augmented reality-powered mobile adventure", a digital passport, stamps and badges, leaderboards, and curated itineraries, and quotes Darwish: "Real-time guidance spreads footfall, increases dwell time and supports neighborhood businesses." The independent Sharjah24 republication (https://sharjah24.ae/en/Articles/2025/11/06/Innovation-Hackathon-reimagines-tourism-experience-at-AUS) carries identical names, prize, features, and the footfall quote; the WAM article returned no body text. "Spreads visitor traffic" is a fair paraphrase of "spreads footfall", and "last year" is correct for the 2025 edition relative to the 2026 event (10-11 October 2026). The mentor-name part: the public 2026 event page (https://auscse.com/hackathon/) names no mentors, so it is not verifiable on the open web. It is supported by the organiser's Mentor Profiles deck as transcribed in D:\Sharjah Tourism Hackathon\00_Hackathon_Brief.md (section 7), which lists Afif Zughayer (Founder, Amana Vision) and Mahmoud Darwish (Founder, ReteIntel) among the eight 2026 mentors. The claim is carefully worded as a name match, not an identity claim, which is appropriate since no source establishes the mentors are the same individuals as the 2025 team members. No number, date, or name is off.
